author: Major_Lue
body:
I'm assuming you're T10. Endless isn't paticularly worth it prior to then, but most of the concepts should still apply even at T9.  


You want to set up ward with Divine Bastion for 100% absorption and build enough turns to last you throughout the gauntlet. Use all your buffs like Att/Mag/Def/Res ++/+, elemental resistances and such. Then, as realm, get to 1hp and hit things with your best skill (usually Pavane from charmer). Pay attention to statuses.  


I do want to make this clear though: **Realmshifter is not good at endless.** It's a servicable class for it but if you truly want to get a solid endless farm going then Heretic is by far the preferred class. Realm being the second least preferred after Beowulf.

author: GorgyShmorgy
body:
Ay don't let the elitist douche bags get to you. Realmshifter is not "bad at endless". You can make it plenty far and earn plenty of orn in a single run. 

The right build on RS will clear 100 floors in 20 minutes without blinking. My current best run is around 154. Current best orn in a single run is just over 1m. 

Yes, Heretic is strong, but that doesn't mean Realmshifter can't do endless. Willing to best most of the "ehhhhh RS is bad at endless bla bla" douches have no idea how to play the class properly. Try the strategy I mentioned and you'll see.

author: GorgyShmorgy
body:
I do it as RS/Charmer using Divine Bastion and Double Edge to 1hp. I frequently make it to 120+ current best at 154.

I start the gauntlet with Kerberos pet, once I have lightning alignment I flee and swap to Ashen Phoenix. Stack about 200 turns of ward, get all the resistances on and lightning affinity. Once buffed, warded, and Double Edged down to 1hp, start swinging Pavane. I deal somewhere around 100k damage per turn until pretty far in the gauntlet.
